04 / KNOW WHAT YOU'RE SEEING

Real Earth. Imagined story.

REAL NASA IMAGES

What is observed?

The 1884 and 2022 global frames and the 2000, 2010, 2020, and 2024 Dhaka images are real, dated NASA views. The Dhaka images show land surface temperature.

IMAGINED STORY

What is made up?

Echo, the broken message, the family, street scenes, future paths, and effects of your choices are parts of the game story. 2035 and 2050 are possibilities, not NASA predictions.

SOUND + WORDS

How do I play?

The scan reads image color, brightness, and position to make original sound. Every sound clue also has words. You can finish the game with sound off.

Want the detailed sources? Open the game's Data Desk.
